target_customer: Manufacturers and industrial distributors with disconnected software and machines
problem: Industrial companies rely on people to coordinate disconnected systems, and automating this has needed bespoke forward deployed engineering. Faraday builds reinforcement learning environments around each company's workflows so agents can improve on their own.
business_model: Enterprise software and services for AI agents, sold per deployment (Faraday Cage m1 for manufacturing, d1 for distribution)
product_category: Industrial AI agent platform and operations software

founders.name: Datta Kaligotla
founders.background_notes: One search summary also lists Boeing; the YC page does not.

founders.name: Oscar Rangel
founders.background_notes: Built factory systems at Worthington Steel and shipped medical devices at Stryker, per YC page.

competitors.name: Didero
competitors.what: Agentic AI for manufacturing procurement on top of ERP systems

competitors.name: Magentic
competitors.what: AI digital workers for procurement and supply chain at industrial companies

competitors.name: SupplyCo AI
competitors.what: Agents for quoting and order entry for manufacturers and distributors on top of ERP and CRM

technical_complexity.rationale: Automatically generating RL environments from each customer's data and machines, with agents checked against them, is hard for a two person team and integrations with industrial systems are bespoke.

defensibility.rationale: Per customer environments and accumulated corrections could compound, but the company is two people at batch start and many funded rivals sell similar agents on top of ERP.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Too early to know; the company launched in 2026-10 and nothing has happened yet.

market_need_then: Industrial firms run on legacy ERP and spreadsheets and many 2026 startups raised money to put agents on top of them, which shows buyer and investor interest. No customer evidence for Faraday itself was found.

branding.domain_note: Uses faradaycompute.com with a compute suffix, so exact faraday.com was not used.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain enterprise language about operations intelligence

branding.brand_signature: Product names Faraday Cage m1 and d1

brand_strength.rationale: Very early; the name is shared with many companies and the physics term, and no press about the brand exists yet.

outcome_analysis: Faraday joined YC in Fall 2026 as a two person team and launched around late October 2026, so there is no outcome yet. Its founders have factory and industrial software experience, which fits the problem, but many funded startups already sell agents on top of ERP systems to manufacturers. The assessment is a forecast, not a result.
notes: No funding information found beyond a Dealroom listing of a 125K seed with no date or investor, unverified single aggregator and not recorded as a round. Outcome searches found no news about the company; launch date of 2026-10-29 comes from a Digg aggregator post. Name origin not found. Competitor entries are dated 2026 by their sources but several lack exact months.
